title: K/DA Live Show Launch
tagline: A brand activation that launched K/DA, Riot's virtual pop group, live on the biggest stage in esports — and drove the highest-grossing skin line in Riot history.

body: K/DA was Riot's most ambitious IP launch in over a decade: a virtual pop group of League of Legends champions, with game development, marketing, music and esports all behind it. The brand needed a launch moment big enough to make fans fall for a band that didn't physically exist — and buy into it.

A live performance with AR characters interacting in real time with real performers had never been done. We built everything from the ground up — custom technology, original character assets and animation synced perfectly to the choreography happening live on stage.

I pitched the activation: debut K/DA live at the World Championship, with the virtual idols sharing the stage with their real-world vocalists — turning a product launch into a performance fans would watch, share and remember. I oversaw all creative integration, keeping the band, the song and the brand moment working as one.

As creative lead, I sourced and managed the external partners that brought the band to life. Over seven months, we modeled the characters from scratch, recorded the choreography with a motion-capture studio, refined the animation and applied it to the digital performers — all in close collaboration with creative teams across Riot.
led: Pitched the live debut as the brand activation at the heart of the K/DA launch
Oversaw character modeling, mocap and animation

metrics.k: Highest-grossing skin line in Riot history

impact.note: A massively successful launch: K/DA became the highest-grossing skin line in Riot Games' history, and the debut drew more than 100 million viewers — a cultural milestone for gaming and entertainment.
